name: Innova Capital
decision_note: Warsaw-based mid-cap buyout private equity firm (controlling stakes; Innova/7 EUR 407m); real and active (Punkta Group corporate insurance business, Mar 2025) but not VC, so outside the cz-vc pilot.

investments.company: Punkta Group corporate insurance distribution and services business (ISON Group)

evidence.quote: We are an independent private equity firm established in 1994 in Poland with the objective of investing in controlling stakes of mid-sized companies in the CEE region.
In April 2024, the firm closed its seventh fund, achieving a record EUR 407m.
Innova Capital, a leading private equity firm in Central and Eastern Europe (CEE), announces its acquisition of Punkta Group's corporate insurance distribution and services business.
This transaction is a key milestone to accelerate the implementation of Innova Capital's investment strategy, which focuses on backing high-growth companies in key sectors of the economy.

analyst_notes: Quick S1 dossier. Innova/7 closed 'In April 2024' (month only; date set to 2024-04-01) at EUR 407m; funds page also says seven funds with a combined EUR 1.6bn. Release detail pages show only the year; dates 2025-03-17 (Punkta) and 2025-03-13 (Proservice Finteco / 50% of IFDS) are from the dated news listing at https://innovacap.com/press/. Newest item on the site is the OSHEE exit to Mid Europa Partners (2026-02-16); add-on deals by portfolio companies (Prime Label / Arti-Bau, 2025-08-05) also listed. Ticket not stated on the pages read; the CVCA profile (class D, 2020) says EUR 20-50m. Polish/Luxembourg entities not looked up.
